Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

external adjective

also outward, outer, exterior, from outside

classical

Cic. N.D. 2.26: externus et adventīcius tepor (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Ac. 2.4: illa externa, “outward goods” (Lewis & Short)

externus, externa, externum

declension

external, outward; foreign

What comes from outside or belongs to the outside; with regard to one’s family or country it is foreign, as of an enemy from abroad (Cic. Cat. 2.29) (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • exterior, exterius — outer, on the outside

    adjective, comparative of exter, declension · also used · classical

    The outer of two: the outer wall, the outer side; the opposite of interior.

Examples

  • nōs autem illa externa cum multīs: haec interiōra cum paucīs ex ipsō saepe cognōvimus

    but those outward things we often learned from him with many others, these inner ones with fewCic. Ac. 2.4 (Lewis & Short)

See also outside, inside.
